description: Obsidian links. [[inner]] is a link; ![[inner]] is an embed. The inner text splits on the first | (alias, or an embed's size), then on the first # of what's left: #^ gives a block id, # a heading. The target is what precedes, trimmed of spaces and tabs. An empty target ([[#Heading]], [[#^block]]) is the same file; with no heading or block either ([[|alias]]) it is not a link. A \| splits like | (its backslash is dropped); any other backslash is a character of its part, so [[Foo\_bar]] has the target Foo\_bar. Inner text never holds [, ] or a line break.
